_README: Read off the 9 Aug 2026 shoot, frames IMG_6178, IMG_6179, IMG_6181, IMG_6186, IMG_6187. Brand names are only listed where the label is legible in the photograph at full resolution. Nothing here is inferred from a category or a supplier list. If a brand cannot be read, it is not in this file — the counts describe what is visibly on the shelf instead. NO PRICES, and note that both IMG_6178 and IMG_6181 carry visible green price stickers, so only tag-free crops of those frames may ship.

_excluded.note: One torch display in IMG_6178 carries a brand that appears on the owner's excluded list. The item photographed is a butane torch rather than the product the rule was written about, but a brand-level rule is a brand-level rule and I am not going to relitigate it on a technicality. It is left out. The brand is named in the commit that added this file, deliberately not here: this file is imported into the bundle, so writing it here would ship the very string the guard exists to keep off the site.

groups.name: Grinders
groups.lede: Two full shelves of them, and the case is the first thing you see at the counter.
groups.detail: Four-piece metal grinders in anodised finishes — gold, cobalt, red, violet, rainbow — alongside printed and patterned lids, knurled and diamond-cut bodies, clear-window grinders so you can see the chamber, and compact two-piece pocket grinders.

groups.name: Torch lighters
groups.lede: A case built around jet flame.
groups.detail: Single, double and triple-jet torches; angled-neck table torches; slim pen torches; soft-touch bodies in purple, pink, yellow, red and blue. Refillable butane throughout.

groups.name: Everyday lighters
groups.detail: Full BIC displays, Clipper, jumbo and standard disposables, keychain torch lighters, and printed novelty sleeves.

groups.name: Digital scales
groups.detail: Precision pocket scales down to 0.01 g, jewellery scales, and a 3000 g low-profile platform scale.

groups.name: Storage & stash
groups.detail: Airtight glass jars with cork and bamboo lids, wooden dugouts with one-hitters, silicone containers in every size from thumb-tip concentrate pots to stackable jars, and wooden storage spheres.

groups.name: Metal pipes & one-hitters
groups.lede: Brass, and built to disappear in a pocket.
groups.detail: Brass bullet-style one-hitters, taster bats, and metal hand pipes that break down for cleaning.

groups.name: Trays & tools
groups.lede: The bits that make the rest work.
groups.detail: Rolling trays in metal and silicone, dab and packing tools, cleaning brushes, screens, and silicone mats.
